title: Finance » Transaction History
content: Finance » Transaction History Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046232 The Transaction History page provides the admin with an overview of the billing history and expected payments for all site members. This article explains all the features available on this page. It can be accessed by navigating to Finance  »  Transaction History in the admin area. The Transaction History page is organized into five tabs: Payments Received Upcoming Payments Past Due Refunded Stopped Payments Received The Payments Received tab records all payments collected from members and displays the total amount received, which matches the Finance Snapshot in the Dashboard. This total includes payments for services like leads, pay-per-posts, digital downloads, and membership subscriptions. This section provides key transaction details such as Invoice ID, date paid, member’s name, product, and amount paid (1). An Actions button (2) allows the Admin to manage invoices efficiently. Quick Actions The Actions button (1) in the far-right column opens several invoice-related options (2). Send Email Notification: Click this button to send an email notification to the member. It will display the Compose Email pop-up and the system will automatically use the invoice_payment_received email template when clicking this button under the Payments Received tab. Refund Payment: Click on this button to refund the payment to the member and label the invoice as Refunded . Mark as Unpaid: Mark this invoice as Unpaid . This is useful if the member disputes the charge with their bank or the payment is refunded directly through the payment gateway and not through the website. This enables an admin to track this billing event in the admin area in cases where it could not be tracked automatically. Changing the status of an invoice in this way will move the invoice to the appropriate tab (Upcoming Payments or Past Due, depending on when the invoice was originally due). Download Invoice: Download a copy of this invoice in PDF format. Members can also download PDF copies of invoices through their Member Dashboard in the Billing History section. End Subscription: Use this button to stop (Cancel) the subscription related to this invoice, and do not collect any future payments connected to this subscription. If there are unpaid invoices related to the Subscription, the system will cancel those invoices as well. Clicking it opens the Confirm End Subscription window, which has an optional Reason for cancelling box (up to 1,000 characters). A reason entered there is saved with the cancellation and shown on the Finance » Search Subscriptions page. Full steps: How Do I Cancel Payment Subscriptions - Orders . * Note: The End Subscription button will only appear when the invoice has an active subscription associated with it. Delete This Invoice: Delete the invoice completely from the system.  This is permanent and cannot be undone. Delete Subscription: Delete the subscription completely from the system.  This will not delete any invoices related to the subscription but will delete the subscription itself from the system and will not collect any new invoices related to the subscription.  This is permanent and cannot be undone.  It is better to choose End Subscription in most cases unless there is a specific need to delete the subscription from the system entirely. Upcoming Payments The Upcoming Payments tab displays all payments scheduled for processing within the next 14 days, making it easier to track upcoming dues and contact members if needed. Above the tab name, the total amount of upcoming payments is also shown for quick reference. In this section, the Due Date column is organized in ascending order rather than descending. Key details such as Invoice ID, status, date paid, member’s name, product (membership plan), and amount due are displayed. Quick Actions The Actions button (1) in the far-right column opens several options for the invoice (2). Send Email Notification: Click this button to send an email notification to the member. Clicking this button will display the Compose Email pop-up and the system will automatically use the invoice_reminder_notice_first template when clicking this button under the Upcoming Payments tab. Mark as Paid: It allows marking this specific member as Paid. This is used for members who pay directly by bank deposit or with other payment methods that are not the default payment gateway. This way there is a record on the site. It allows changing the status of the payment from Unpaid to Paid, if this button is used, the system will move this payment to the Payments Received tab. Download Invoice: The admin can download the invoice for this specific payment. Keep in mind that in the member's dashboard, they can also download invoices. Stop This Payment: As this payment is going to be taken in the next 14 days, it can be stopped if needed. Using this option, the subscription (order) is not going to be cancelled, it will only cancel this specific payment. End Subscription: Use this button to stop (Cancel) the subscription related to that specific payment. If there are unpaid invoices, the system will cancel them as well. Clicking it opens the Confirm End Subscription window, which has an optional Reason for cancelling box (up to 1,000 characters). A reason entered there is saved with the cancellation and shown on the Finance » Search Subscriptions page. Full steps: How Do I Cancel Payment Subscriptions - Orders . * Remember that the system will create the unpaid invoice 13 days before the next due date. Also, the End Subscription button will only appear when the invoice has an active subscription associated with it. Delete This Invoice: It will delete the invoice from the admin and member's account. Delete Subscription: This one deletes the subscription from the admin and member's account. Past Due Tab The Past Due tab displays all payments that the system was unable to process. These payments remain visible until the day after their due date. For instance, if a payment is due on the 29th and the system fails to process it, it will appear in this section until the 30th. The total amount of past-due payments is also displayed above the tab name for quick reference. In this section, key payment details such as Invoice ID, status, date paid, member’s name, product (membership level), and amount due are listed. Quick Actions An Actions button (1) on the right opens additional management options for the admin (2). Send Email Notification: Click this button to send an email notification to the member. Clicking  this button will display the Compose Email pop-up and the system will automatically use the invoice_overdue_notice_first template when clicking  this button under the Past Due tab. Collect Payment: Payment can be collected manually. If the payment is taken successfully, it means that there are no issues with that card, but the money couldn't be taken because the bank declined the transaction on the first attempt, insufficient funds, etc. Mark as Paid: It allows marking this specific member as Paid. This is used for members who pay directly by bank deposit or with other payment methods that are not the default payment gateway. This way, there is a record on the site. It allows changing the status of the payment from Unpaid to Paid. By using this button, the system will move this payment to the Payments Received tab. Download Invoice: Download a copy of this invoice in PDF format. Members can also download PDF copies of invoices through their Member Dashboard in the Billing History section. Stop This Payment: As this payment is going to be taken in the next 14 days, it can be stopped if needed. Using this option, the subscription (order) is not going to be cancelled, it will only cancel this specific payment. End Subscription: Use this button to stop (Cancel) the subscription related to this invoice. If there are unpaid invoices related to the subscription, the system will cancel them as well. Clicking it opens the Confirm End Subscription window, which has an optional Reason for cancelling box (up to 1,000 characters). Full steps: How Do I Cancel Payment Subscriptions - Orders . Delete This Invoice: It will delete the invoice from the admin and member's account. Delete Subscription: This one deletes the subscription from the admin and member's account. Bulk Manual Invoice Collection Since the billing system attempts to process each payment only once, unsuccessful transactions require manual follow-up. Payments can be collected manually, and members can update their credit card information if needed. There is a button at the top right that attempts to collect all selected invoices. On the Past Due tab (1), tick the checkbox next to each invoice to collect, then click Attempt to Collect All Selected Invoices (2). Updating Account Status If the status of a member is Active, but it needs to be changed manually to Past Due , the system will show this error (1) and the change is not saved: This error only appears while the advanced setting Suspend Past Due Member Accounts is ON. With it ON, the status cannot be changed from Active to Past Due unless the member has at least one past-due invoice. The setting is OFF by default. To override this setting and manually update each member's account status, the advanced setting Suspend Past Due Member Accounts needs to be set to OFF. It is on the Sign Ups & Billing tab of Settings » Advanced Settings , under Member Account Status. Refunded The Refunded Payments section displays all successful payments that have been refunded. Above the tab name, the total amount of refunded payments is shown for easy reference. This section includes key details such as the Invoice ID, status, date paid, member’s name, product (membership level), and amount refunded, allowing administrators to track and manage refunded transactions efficiently. Quick Actions An Actions button (1) on the right opens additional management options for the admin (2). Send Email Notification: Click on this button to send an email notification to the member. Clicking on this button will display the Compose Email pop-up and the system will automatically use the invoice_refund_confirmation template. Mark as Paid: It allows marking this specific member as Paid. This is used for members who pay directly by bank deposit or with other payment methods that are not the default payment gateway. This way, there is a record on the site. It allows changing the status of the payment from Unpaid to Paid, using this button the system will move this payment to the Payments Received tab. Download Invoice: Download a copy of this invoice in PDF format. Members can also download PDF copies of invoices through their Member Dashboard in the Billing History section. End Subscription: Use this button to stop (Cancel) the subscription related to this invoice. If there are unpaid invoices related to the subscription, the system will cancel them as well. Clicking it opens the Confirm End Subscription window, which has an optional Reason for cancelling box (up to 1,000 characters). Full steps: How Do I Cancel Payment Subscriptions - Orders . Delete This Invoice: It will delete the invoice from the admin and member's account. Delete Subscription: This one deletes the subscription from the admin and member's account. Stopped The Stopped Payments section displays payments that were scheduled for processing but were stopped and cancelled before completion. Above the tab name, the total amount of stopped payments is shown for easy reference. This section includes important details such as the Invoice ID, status, date paid, member’s name, product (membership plan), and amount. Additionally, an Actions button on the right allows admins to manage these payments. Quick Actions Mark as Paid: This option allows marking this specific member as Paid. This is used for members who pay directly by bank deposit or with other payment methods that are not the default payment gateways. This way, there is a record on the site. It allows changing the status of the payment from Unpaid to Paid, using this button the system will move this payment to the Payments Received tab. Download Invoice: Download a copy of this invoice in PDF format. Members can also download PDF copies of invoices through their Member Dashboard in the Billing History section. End Subscription: Use this button to stop (Cancel) the subscription related to that specific payment. If there are unpaid invoices the system will cancel them as well. Clicking it opens the Confirm End Subscription window, which has an optional Reason for cancelling box (up to 1,000 characters). A reason entered there is saved with the cancellation and shown on the Finance » Search Subscriptions page. Full steps: How Do I Cancel Payment Subscriptions - Orders . * Remember that the system will create the unpaid invoice 13 days before the next past due. Also, the End Subscription button will only appear when the invoice has an active subscription associated with it. Delete This Invoice: It will delete the invoice from the admin and member's account. Delete Subscription: This one deletes the subscription from the admin and member's account. Delete Several Stopped Invoices at Once The Stopped tab also has a checkbox next to each invoice and a select-all checkbox in the table header. To delete several stopped invoices in one step, select them and click List Actions » Delete Selected . The steps are explained in Delete Several Stopped Invoices at Once below. Member Information In all of the tabs, hovering over the member's name (1) will display information about the member along with several links to take actions on the member (2): Account Details: Links to the member's Account Details page, which contains an overview of information about the specific member. Quick Edit: Edit several attributes of the member without logging into their account. Send Email: Send an email to the member. Use an existing email template or send a custom email. Change Password: Assign a new password for the member. View Live Profile: View the live profile of the member as seen by visitors to the website. Login as Member: Login to the member's dashboard as if they logged in to their account. Payment History: See the complete billing history of this member. Delete Account: Delete the member's account completely. Billing Email Settings To configure the billing email settings, read this article: Billing Reminder Email Settings Income Reports At the top right is the "Income Reports" button, which has 3 options: Daily Income Report Monthly Income Report Recurring Income Estimator These reports cannot be downloaded. However, the tables can be selected and copied, then the information can be pasted into an Excel sheet. Report Details These reports are an estimate and exact totals may slightly differ based on the timestamp and timezone defined by the payment gateway. This report is generated in the time chosen in the General Settings >> Location Tab >> Hour of Day to Collect Recurring Payments: Settings » General Settings » Localization . Ask BD Butler Section - Revenue Insights & More The BD AI assistant is designed to analyze website financial data and provide quick answers regarding revenue, payments, subscriptions, and general website transaction history. Here's an article with more information about this: BD Butler . Transaction Search Filter Options The Transaction History includes 14 search filter options: Member name or ID# Member email address Product Name (for example; name of the membership plan or digital product purchased) Membership plan name Billing cycles Member Account Status Invoice Status Invoice ID# Subscription ID# Coupon Code name Invoice Date Range Sales Rep Name Sort by Newest or Oldest option Option Show or Hide Billing Emails Sent Billing Cycles When searching by Billing Cycles, the admin can select more than one option here: Within the Billing Cycles drop-down, there are also options to sort by three subscription statuses: Any - This will display the invoices for members that have active and ended (cancelled) subscriptions. Only Active - This will display the invoices for members that have an active subscription. Only Ended - This will display the invoices for members that have an ended (cancelled) subscription Sales Rep The Sales Rep Name option will only display if the settings are enabled. Here's an article with more details about How to Activate Sales Representative Tracking For Members . List Actions Dropdown In this section, called " List Actions ", it is possible to export data, create smart lists, and delete invoices in bulk to help organize and manage information efficiently. Export Transactions Under this dropdown, it is possible to export the currently selected results by clicking on Export Current Results. Clicking this opens the Export Transactions window. Tick the fields to export under Available Export Fields (1); the chosen fields are listed under Selected Fields (2). Then click Continue with Export (3), or Cancel Export to close the window without exporting: Available Transaction History Export Fields Member Account Status ( active ) Company Name ( company ) Credit Value ( credit ) Date Paid ( datepaid ) Email Address ( member_email ) First Name ( first_name ) Invoice ID# ( invoice_id ) Invoice Link ( invoice_link ) Invoice Status ( invoice_status ) Last Name ( last_name ) Notes ( notes ) Phone Number ( phone_number ) Product Name ( product_name ) Subscription Created Date ( subscription_created_date ) Subscription ID# ( subscription_id ) Subscription Name ( subscription_name ) Sub Total ( subtotal ) Total ( total ) User ID# ( user_id ) Billing Address ( billing_address ) For this action to appear, the Export Member Data add-on has to be enabled on the site. Transactions History Smart List It is also possible to create a Smart List of the currently selected results by clicking  Create Smart List from Results. Clicking this will display a pop-up where the name of the smart list can be entered (1): The smart list will be created after clicking Yes, continue (2). A confirmation window then shows the smart list name. To open the new smart list right away, click the Go To <name of the smart list> Smart List link (1): Delete Selected Invoices can be deleted in bulk from the tabs that show a checkbox next to each invoice: Past Due , Refunded and Stopped , plus Payments Received and Upcoming Payments when the Billing Reminder Emails add-on is enabled. Deleted invoices cannot be recovered. Tick the checkbox next to each invoice to delete (1). The checkbox in the table header selects every invoice currently loaded on the page (results load 20 at a time). Click List Actions (2), then click Delete Selected (3). If no invoice is selected, the message "No Invoices Selected" appears. In the Confirm Bulk Delete window, choose one of the two options: Yes, delete invoices and subscriptions: deletes the selected invoices and the subscriptions they belong to. A subscription that still has other active invoices is kept, the same as when a single invoice is deleted. No, only delete invoices: deletes only the selected invoices and leaves every subscription untouched. Both options lead to a final Are you sure? window. Click Yes, continue to delete, or No, cancel to stop without deleting anything. When the deletion finishes, the message " Deleted! X invoice(s) deleted successfully." appears and the list reloads. If some invoices could not be deleted, the message reads " Done X of N invoice(s) deleted. Y could not be deleted." and the invoices that were not deleted remain in the list. Send Bulk Email Dropdown If the site has the "Billing Reminder Emails" Add-On , the option to send out certain bulk payment emails appears for 3 tabs: Payments Received Upcoming Payments Past Due Click here to review the emails sent out: Billing Reminder Email Templates Transaction Notes Admins have the ability to add notes to all invoice types, including Received, Upcoming, Past Due, Refunded, and Stopped invoices. Admins can also leave notes when they attempt to contact a member, which helps with tracking billing more efficiently. Click Add Note under the product name, type the note (1) and click Save Note (2). Additional Information Shown The transaction history results will also display additional information depending on the member purchase. Leads If the member purchased a lead, the row shows the lead number (1) and no View Details link. View Details (2) only appears when the payment belongs to a subscription. Pay-Per-Post Purchased Limit If the Vip Add-Ons were installed on the site and a member paid per post, the payment information will appear in the Payments Received tab as "Add a New Name of the Post Type " (1). The "Add a New" wording comes from the purchase_limit_for text label. In the screenshot below the member paid for a Classified. Coupon Codes If a member used a Coupon Code during the sign-up process, the code used in this transaction will display as a clickable Coupon Code: <code> link (1) that opens the coupon in Finance » Coupon Codes :

title: Toolbox » Form Manager
content: Toolbox » Form Manager Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046441 The Form Manager is a core module of the Brilliant Directories platform, as it contains all forms used throughout the site. Forms allow members and visitors to submit information, making this the place to create, edit, and customize how data is collected. How to Access the Form Manager To access the Form Manager, navigate to Toolbox >> Form Manager : Default Forms Every Brilliant Directories site includes a set of default forms. These forms are labeled with a DEFAULT FORM tag: To learn more about default form types, see Default Form Types Customized Forms New websites are launched without customized forms: Once a default form is customized, it appears above the Default Forms section: To learn how to customize a form, see How to Customize a Form Bulk Actions Bulk actions are available for custom and newly created forms: To learn more about bulk actions, see Bulk Actions for Forms Form Filters Filters organize forms by status, type, alphabetical order, or last update: Filter by Status View forms that are currently active or disabled. Filter by Type: Member Listings Forms associated with membership listing sections such as Contact Details, Additional Details, or About. Filter by Type: Post Types Forms related to post types such as Classifieds, Albums, or Blog Posts. Filter by Type: General Forms not associated with listings or post types. Allowed Frontend HTML Tags Site owners can control which HTML elements are allowed in front-end forms. This setting is located under Settings >> Advanced Settings >> Allowed Frontend HTML Tags : Note: For security reasons, the following HTML elements are never allowed: <input>, <textarea>, <link>, <form>, <meta>, <applet>, <frame>, <iframe>, <script>, <style>, <base>, <body>, <html>, <object>, <?>, <?php Important Information Forms cannot be imported or exported. Advanced searching and filtering can be performed using SQL queries. The Leads Form is tied directly to the Leads System. Most changes should be made in Lead Settings . Keeping the default Get Matched form and only adding new fields is recommended, to avoid conflicts.

title: How to Create New Membership Plans - Add Free or Paid Membership Plans
content: How to Create New Membership Plans - Add Free or Paid Membership Plans Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046487 This article explains how to set up free membership plans. With a free membership plan, members do not need to pay to join the website.The same process applies to paid membership plans by configuring a sign-up price. To set this up, follow the steps below: 1. Navigate to the admin and click  Finance » Membership Plans. Find the membership plan that needs to be set as "Free" and click Edit: 2. Then go to the "Sign Ups & Upgrades" tab and make sure that the "Account Type" is Free . When 'Free' is selected, the pricing options will be hidden. The only pricing option that remains visible is Price to Purchase Leads Usually, free members need to pay for leads and any other paid posts or services offered by the admin. 3. Also in the Sign Ups & Upgrades tab, make sure to select "Sign Up Email Sent" --> "Welcome-basic" and also make sure the "After Sign Up, Set Account Status As:" is set to "Inactive Account, Requires Email Verification". This way, members must verify their email addresses before their accounts become active 4. When everything has been set up, create a test member. To do this, scroll up and click the "Sign Up Page" button: The 'Select a Payment Option' section will no longer appear and the system will display this form where members can add their email and password. Additional documentation for setting up recurring payments is available here: Setting up Recurring Payments To create one-time subscriptions, read this article: Setting up One Time Payments To edit the amounts displayed on the /join page, read these articles: Side-By-Side Pricing Plans: How To Link Membership Plans To The Price Matrix Guide 5. How to Edit Public Pricing Page (the /join page)

title: Free Trial Period
content: Free Trial Period Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046572 Overview The Free Trial Period add-on allows administrators to offer a specified number of free days on individual paid membership plans. Depending on the website’s payment gateway and selected authorization option, members may be required to enter payment information during signup. If a member does not cancel before the trial ends, the regular membership payment becomes due. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Free Trial Period Add-On Features and Benefits : Increase paid membership signups Add a free trial period to individual membership packages. Choose how many days the trial period lasts Trial info is automatically displayed on checkout pages Payment information can be optional or required, depending on the selected authorization option and payment gateway. Members are automatically charged once their trial ends Members are not charged if they cancel before their trial ends How to Enable a Free Trial for a Membership Plan 1. Open the Membership Plan Go to Finance » Membership Plans . Click Edit for the membership plan that will offer the trial. 2. Open the Sign Ups & Upgrades Tab Select the Sign Ups & Upgrades tab. 3. Enable the Free Trial Period Two sets of options are available and can be configured independently: New Signups: For members subscribing to this plan for the first time. Plan Changes: For existing members switching from another plan to this one. For either option, set Enable Free Trial Period to Yes . 4. Specify Number of Trial Days In Number of Free Trial Days , enter the duration of the trial. For example, enter 7 to offer a seven-day free trial. Click Save Changes when the configuration is complete. Credit Card Requirements and Authorization Options Under Free Trial Additional Options , select how payment information will be handled during the free trial. The available options depend on whether the website uses an on-site or off-site payment gateway. Related Article: Supported Payment Gateways: On-Site and Off-Site Payment Gateways Off-Site Payment Gateways No credit card required for free trial: Members can begin the free trial without providing payment information. They must add a valid payment method before paid billing can begin. On-Site Payment Gateways No credit card required for free trial: Members can begin the free trial without providing payment information. They must add a valid payment method before paid billing can begin. Add credit card on file without authorization: Members must provide a credit card during signup. The card is saved but is not charged or authorized until the free trial ends. Authorize a $1.00 charge when card is required: Members must provide a credit card. A $1 authorization is processed to verify that the card is valid and active. Authorize full subscription amount when card is required: Members must provide a credit card. The full subscription amount is authorized to confirm that sufficient funds are available. The regular payment is processed when the free trial ends. What Members See at Checkout When No Credit Card Is Required Credit-card fields are hidden during checkout. The member must add a valid payment method before paid billing begins. If payment cannot be collected when the trial ends, the member is marked as Past Due . When Authorization Is Required When a credit-card authorization option is selected, the checkout form displays an authorization notice explaining how the member’s card will be handled. Customize the Authorization Message To customize the authorization title and message: Go to Settings » Text Labels . Search for Credit Card Authorization . Edit the following labels: Credit Card Authorization Title Credit Card Authorization Message Save the changes. Verify the Free Trial for New Signups After saving the membership plan, open its signup page to confirm that the free-trial information appears correctly. Go to Finance » Membership Plans . Find the configured membership plan and click Edit . Click Sign Up Page at the top of the page. In the Select a Payment Option section, confirm that the trial duration and payment start date are displayed correctly. Verify the Free Trial During a Plan Upgrade Free trials can also apply when an existing member upgrades to an eligible membership plan. The destination plan must have the free trial enabled and must be configured as an available upgrade option. When the member selects the plan from the Upgrade/Downgrade page, the trial duration and payment start date appear with the plan’s payment information: For instructions on making the plan available during an upgrade, see How to Setup Upgrade/Downgrade Options for Membership Plans . Customize the Free Trial Display Text When a free trial is enabled, the trial duration and payment start date appear during checkout: To customize this text: Go to Settings » Text Labels . Search for Free Trial . Edit the applicable labels. Save the changes. The following five labels are available for editing: Label Description Variable Name Default Text Line 1 Before Days free_trial_period_line1_before This plan includes a. Line 1 After Days free_trial_period_line1_after DAY FREE TRIAL. Line 2 Before Start Date free_trial_period_line2_before Your payment will start on. Line 2 After Start Date free_trial_period_line2_after Type additional text if needed. Line 3 (Additional Info) free_trial_period_line3 Additional text displayed under date. The “before” and “after” labels are combined with a dynamically generated value, such as the number of trial days or the payment start date. Additional Notes The following conditions apply when using the Free Trial Period Add-On: Members must cancel before the trial ends to avoid the first regular membership charge. Free trials can apply to both new signups and eligible membership-plan upgrades. When no card is collected during signup, the member must add a valid payment method before paid billing begins. If payment cannot be collected when the trial ends, the member is marked Past Due . Past-due transactions can be reviewed under Finance » Transaction History » Past Due . Additional Resources Free Trial Payment Intents - Stripe Finance » Transaction History

title: Account Details Section For Members
content: Account Details Section For Members Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046936 Navigation Path: Admin Dashboard » My Members » Search Members » Actions Dropdown » Account Details The Account Details section provides a comprehensive administrative view of an individual member record. It is organized into seven tabs, each covering a distinct area of member data. The seven tabs are: Overview Transactions Subscriptions Profile Analytics Member Content Activity Member Reviews Overview The Overview tab presents a consolidated summary of the selected member's core account information, organized into the following sections: Contact Information — Displays the member's name, email address, phone number, and address details. Membership Information — Displays the member's assigned plan, account status, join date, and related account-level settings. Lead Activity Stats — Displays an at-a-glance summary of lead-related activity associated with the member's profile. Internal Admin Notes — Displays any notes entered for this member via the Internal Admin Notes field in the Quick Edit Module . These notes are visible only to administrators and are not displayed to the member or site visitors. ⚠ NOTE — Overview Is Read-Only: No fields in the Overview tab are editable from this view. To modify contact or account information, use the Quick Edit module or the member's full Edit Profile section. Transactions The Transactions tab displays the complete payment and transaction history for the selected member. The layout and data format mirrors the global Transaction History view found under Finance , but is filtered to show records belonging to the selected member only. The CC Info button allows the administrator to view and edit the credit card information on file for the selected member. Reference: CC Info The New Order button allows the administrator to create a new order for the selected member directly from within the Transactions tab. ⚠ BEHAVIORAL NOTE — Button Availability Is Conditional: The New Order button is only displayed when no active subscription exists for the member. When an active subscription is present, the transaction history is displayed without the New Order button. If a member's subscription has lapsed or was never created, the New Order button will appear in its place, allowing the administrator to initiate a new subscription for that member. Subscriptions The Subscriptions tab displays the complete subscription history for the selected member, including the active subscription record, billing cycle, next invoice date, and any coupon code applied at the time of signup (if applicable). Selecting a coupon code displayed in this tab opens the coupon's configuration details. The following subscription management actions are available via the Actions dropdown within this tab: Action Description Edit Subscription Allows modification of the member's active subscription settings. Cancel Subscription Initiates the cancellation of the member's active subscription. References: Edit Subscription · Cancel Subscription ⚠ NOTE — Cancellation Date Display: When a subscription is cancelled, the Next Invoice Date field in the subscription record is replaced by the cancellation date. This is the system's indicator that no further billing cycles are scheduled for that subscription. Profile Analytics The Profile Analytics tab displays page visit statistics for the selected member's public profile, including visit counts broken down by month, year, and total cumulative visits. ⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Member Profile Analytics: This tab is only visible when both of the following conditions are met: The Member Profile Analytics add-on is active on the site. The "Enable Profile Statistics" setting is enabled within the member's assigned Membership Plan settings. If either condition is not met, the Profile Analytics tab will not appear in the Account Details section for that member. Member Content The Member Content tab displays all posts created by the selected member, including content that has not yet been published. The layout and available actions mirror the global Manage Posts view found under My Content , but is filtered to show only posts belonging to the selected member. ⚠ NOTE — Unpublished Content Is Visible Here: This tab surfaces all content records for the member regardless of publication status. Unpublished, draft, and pending posts are displayed alongside published content. This is the recommended view for auditing a specific member's full content output Activity The Activity tab displays a chronological log of all recorded activity events for the selected member. The layout mirrors the global Activity Tracker found under Dashboard , but is scoped entirely to the selected member's account. Activity records logged in this tab may include login events, profile updates, content submissions, and other system-tracked interactions associated with the member. Member Reviews The Member Reviews tab displays all reviews that have been submitted by site users for the selected member's profile. The layout mirrors the global Member Reviews view found under My Members , but is filtered to show only reviews associated with the selected member. ⚠ NOTE — Review Management: Reviews can be moderated from this tab in the same manner as the global Member Reviews section. Any moderation actions taken here apply only to reviews associated with the selected member.

title: Quick Edit Module For Members
content: Quick Edit Module For Members Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046940 The Quick Edit section for the members can be reached by navigating to: My Members Search Members Quick Edit under Actions dropdown The Quick Edit module provides administrators with direct access to four management tabs for any individual member record without navigating away from the Search Members screen. The four tabs are: Account Details Listing Settings Member Tags Advanced Options Account Details This tab is divided into two sections: Basic Information and Contact Information . Basic Information This section controls core account-level settings for the selected member. Member ID The system displays the member's unique system-assigned ID. This field is read-only and cannot be edited. Account Status The following status values are available for assignment to a member account: Label Description Not Active Manually set by the administrator to deactivate an account. Active Member profile is visible on the front end of the site. Cancelled Applied when a member has cancelled the account. On Hold Used during manual admin approval of new signups. Past Due Applied when the member has an overdue subscription payment. Incomplete Applied when a paid signup encounters an unaccounted error; the account is created but remains unpaid. A member profile is only live and publicly visible on the site when the status is set to Active . ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Status Does Not Control Billing: Changing a member's Account Status does NOT cancel or pause any active billing subscription. Billing management must be handled separately through the subscription and payment system. A member set to "Not Active" or "Cancelled" may still be actively billed if the subscription is not independently cancelled. Membership Plan Displays all Membership Plans currently configured under Finance » Membership Plans . The administrator may reassign a member to a different plan from this field. ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Plan Change Does Not Affect Billing: Changing the Membership Plan assigned to a member does NOT modify or cancel the member's existing subscription. Subscription management must be handled separately. Public Listing Represents (Listing Type) Determines how the member's public profile is displayed. Two options are available: Individual / Person — Profile displays the member's profile photo combined with first and last name. Company / Organization — Profile displays the company logo combined with the company name. Top Level Category Displays all Top-Level Categories configured under My Members » Member Categories . The administrator may reassign the member's primary category from this field. Internal Admin Notes A free-text field for administrator use only. Notes entered here are not visible to the member or to site visitors. This field is intended for internal record-keeping regarding the member account. Contact Information This section contains the member's direct contact and identity information. First, Last, and Company Name Information entered in these fields is displayed directly on the member's public profile. Which fields appear publicly depends on the Listing Type setting (Individual vs. Company) configured in the Basic Information section above. Join Date The member's recorded join date can be reviewed and edited from this field. Phone Number and 2nd Phone Number Primary and secondary phone numbers for the member can be added or updated here. Email Address The member's email address can be added or updated here. ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Email Is the Login Username: The email address entered in this field also serves as the member's login username. Changing this value will change the credentials required for the member to log in to the site. The affected member should be notified of any email address change. Listing Settings This tab contains visibility, location, and lead routing settings for the selected member. Parent ID ADD-ON REQUIRED — Multi-Member Manager: The Parent ID field is only available if the Multi-Member Manager add-on is active on the site. Without this add-on, this setting will not appear. When active, this field allows the administrator to assign, change, or remove a parent member ID. Assigning a parent ID converts the selected member into a sub-account under the designated parent. To assign a parent ID, click the Change Parent Member button. A dropdown search field appears, search by member ID to locate the intended parent. Select the appropriate parent member from the results. ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Eligibility Restriction: Only Active members who share the same Membership Plan AND have the "Sub Accounts" feature enabled within their Membership Plan Settings will appear as assignable parent options. Members not meeting both criteria will not appear in the search results. Stock Image Libraries ⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Stock Photo Library for Posts: This option is only visible if the Stock Photo Library for Posts add-on is active on the site. Homepage Featured Member Order ⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Featured Members On Homepage: This setting is only available if the Featured Members On Homepage add-on is active on the site. When active, this field allows the administrator to specify the display position of the member within the homepage streaming widget. ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Unique Position Enforcement: The system does not permit two members to occupy the same featured position. Verify existing position assignments before making changes. Verified Member? This toggle controls whether the member is displayed with a verified icon badge on their public listing. Setting this to Yes activates the badge display. Full reference: How To Verify A Listing List in All Locations? ⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Multi-Location Listing: This setting is only available if the Multi-Location Listing add-on is active on the site. When active, this toggle determines whether the member's profile is listed across all available site locations. Max. Location Limit ⚠ ADD-ON REQUIRED — Multi-Location Listing: This setting is only available if the Multi-Location Listing add-on is active on the site. When active, this field allows the administrator to override the maximum number of locations this specific member can list, independent of what is defined in the member's Membership Plan settings. CC Lead Emails to Multiple email addresses can be entered in this field. All addresses entered will receive lead notification emails alongside the member. This is intended for use cases where a member represents a company and lead emails need to be routed to additional internal recipients such as sales representatives. Member Tags This tab allows administrators to add or remove tags assigned to the individual member record. Full reference: Member Tags & Tag Groups Advanced Options This tab contains SEO and code injection fields that apply exclusively to the selected member's individual profile page. These settings do not affect site-wide SEO configurations. ⚠ NOTE — SEO Fields Are Optional: All SEO metadata fields in this tab (Meta Title, Meta Keywords, Meta Description, Social Meta Title, Social Meta Description) can be left blank. The platform's existing SEO templates already supply valid metadata to search engines. These fields are intended for profile-specific overrides only. Listing Custom HEAD Code A custom code block that is rendered only within the <head> section of the selected member's profile page. This field does not affect any other pages on the site. Listing Custom FOOTER Code A custom code block rendered in the footer section of the selected member's profile page only. Listing Custom CSS Code Custom CSS entered here applies exclusively to the selected member's profile page. ⚠ NOTE: Do not include <style> tags in this field. The system applies the CSS directly; wrapping tags will cause rendering issues. Customize Listing URL The member's profile URL slug can be edited in this field. URLs entered here should be relative, the full site domain is not required and should not be included. The system also provides an option to fetch the URL from the active SEO template, which resets the slug to match the current SEO template configuration. Fetching the URL also applies the current name-formatting rules: apostrophes are removed, most other punctuation and spaces become hyphens, and underscores are preserved. For example, Ruby’s Clay Studio becomes rubys-clay-studio in the name portion of the URL. This differs from entering a deliberate custom URL. See How To Customize The Member Profile URL Structure for examples and when existing URLs change. ⚠ CRITICAL CAUTION — Dynamic URL Overwrite Risk: If a member later changes their location or categories, the system will automatically update their profile URL, overwriting any custom URL that was previously set. To prevent this automatic override, check the lock checkbox displayed beneath the URL field after entering a custom slug. Listing Meta Title A custom meta title for the selected member's profile page. This field is optional; the platform's SEO templates provide baseline metadata when this field is left blank. Listing Meta Keywords Custom meta keywords for the selected member's profile page. This field is optional. Listing Meta Description A custom meta description for the selected member's profile page. This field is optional. Listing Social Meta Title A custom social media meta title used when the member's profile is shared on social platforms. This field is optional. Listing Social Meta Description A custom social meta description used when the member's profile is shared on social platforms. This field is optional.

title: My Members » Member Categories
content: My Members » Member Categories Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046949 An essential part of the directory's search experience is the ability to filter results by categories. Below, we will provide an overview of this module. For a full explanation of how categories behave on the front-end and back-end, see the Member Categories Overview article. To access member categories, navigate to My Members >> Member Categories : This section is divided into three tabs to display Top , Sub , and Sub-Sub Categories on the site: Each of these tabs will have identical functionality, where categories can be searched by keyword or ID: And can be sorted by the following options: Keep in mind that these sort order options will only apply to the Member Categories view in admin, it will not apply to how categories will display in the front-end. Category Image If needed, an image can be uploaded or removed to each category, which will be used on a streaming widget on the homepage. These images are exclusively for the homepage streaming widget and do not affect individual member profile styling. These images are used when the categories are set to display on the homepage: Displaying Top-Level and Sub-Level Categories On The Homepage Manually Add Categories One of the options to add categories is to do it manually via the Add Top Level Categories button: More information about this process: How To Add Categories Manually From The Admin Member Category Actions This dropdown includes actions like importing, exporting, and editing the code used when displaying the categories on the profile pages. Import Categories Another option to add member categories is via importing a CSV file: More information about this process: How To Import Categories Via CSV File Export Categories The existing member categories can be exported via the Member Category Actions dropdown: More information about this process: How To Export Member Categories Edit Specialties Tab Code And the Specialities tab of member profiles can be edited via the Edit Specialities Tab Code: More information about this process: How To Edit Specialities Tab Code in Member Profiles Category Name and URL Each of the category tabs will have the same display, with additional options to further edit them. The category name can be edited under the Name section: Its live URL can be edited under the Link URL section: Keep in mind that if there are two categories with the same name, the system will assign a unique URL to one of them as can be seen in the image below: Tip: While the system automatically prevents URL conflicts, we recommend keeping your category names unique to ensure clean SEO patterns and a better search experience for your visitors. Sort Order The Sort Order option will determine categories' position in the Homepage streaming widget: Displaying Top-Level Categories On The Homepage This category sort order can also be selected for category searches and drop-downs. Settings > General Settings > Search Settings > Default Category Sort Order: Lead Price by Category If the Lead Price By Category add-on is active on-site, the price can be set under the Lead Price section: Category Related Keywords If the Keywords For Categories add-on is active on-site, related keywords can be added under the Related Keywords section: Total Members per Category Under the Actions column, the total number of members in each category can be seen: If clicked on this section, the system will display the members that are in that category under the Search Members section: Category Live Page Under the Actions dropdown, the live page of the selected categories search results can be found: Delete Category The selected category can be deleted if needed. Clicking the Delete option will open a module showing an overview of the category, including any members assigned to it and any child categories it contains. Bulk Delete Categories All category tabs come with the option to delete categories in bulk. Select multiple categories manually or select all at once. Note: Selecting “All” does not select every category in the system, only the categories visible on the current page. For example, if a category list spans 3 pages, using “Select All” and then deleting will only affect the categories shown on the first page, not those on subsequent pages. Parent Category Under the Sub and Sub-Sub Level Categories tab, an additional search filter called Parent Category can be found: Reassigning Structures Currently, admins can’t reassign the category structure directly through the system settings. To make changes, the best approach is to create a CSV file with the new structure and upload it. Members assigned to the old categories will be unassigned after the update and will need to be recategorized. Admins can bulk-assign members to a Top - Level Category, but not to subcategories.

title: Interactions » Member Reviews
content: Interactions » Member Reviews Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046951 Member Reviews in the Admin The Member Reviews module allows administrators to manage reviews submitted through the website. From this section, reviews can be filtered, moderated, edited, and deleted, while also providing access to review settings and notification preferences. Review Filters Use the available filters to quickly locate and manage reviews. • Review Status – Filter reviews by their current status. • Overall Rating – Filter reviews based on star ratings. • Date Range – Filter reviews by submission date. • Keyword – Search reviews containing specific words or phrases. • Email Address – Search by the review submitter's email address or the member who received the review. Bulk Review Options Multiple reviews can be selected and updated at the same time. Available statuses include: Pending Accepted Declined Waiting for Admin Review Status Database Values For Developers: The corresponding values below are how review statuses are saved in the database. Pending = 0 Accepted = 2 Declined = 3 Waiting for Admin = 4 Member Review Settings A shortcut to the Review Settings module is available from the Member Reviews page. This module includes settings related to: General review settings Profile page display Search results design Notification preferences This button will open the review settings module, which is very similar to the Post Settings section of the admin. An in-depth overview of this module can be reviewed at the following link: Edit Post Settings General Settings Here are the general settings for the post type, allowing the admin to configure and customize the reviews. 1. Protect this Post Type? This option will only become available if the Members-Only Content add on is active on the site. 2. URL Permalink If desired, update the URL of the post type search results. 3. Make 'Email' and 'Name' Fields Readonly When a member writes or replies to another member's review, the system automatically fills in the name, last name, company and email fields. These fields are set to “read-only” by default. To make the fields editable, change the setting to "No" Additional Settings This section includes additional settings such as Display Map When Entering Location Information, Enable Results for Global Website Search and Trigger Webhook for Initial Save or Every Save 4 . Type of Post This will display the post type. 5. Enable Results for Global Website Search Allow the reviews to be part of the Global Website Search, Add-on is required. 6. Trigger Webhook for Initial Save or Every Save? Set when a Webhook will be triggered when a review is submitted. Profile Page Design Move to this tab to set up the information regarding how the reviews will be displayed on the member public profile. 1. Profile Page Tab Title Change the title that will be displayed on the front-end tab. 2. Profile Page Tab Order Choose the position of the profile page tab by selecting a number from the dropdown. Each position will show the name of the selected post type. All positions with no post type assigned are available to choose from. 3. Number of Posts Displayed in Tab Set the number of reviews to be displayed in the member's profile. 4. Profile Page Code The header, page loop, and footer codes of the Profile Page design can be edited. However, we do not recommend changing these options unless it's handled by a developer or someone with knowledge of web development. If desired, after updating the code, it can be switched back to default. Click on this article for more information: How to Customize the Default Post Types Code Search Results Design Edit and set up the search results settings for reviews in this section. 1. Search Results Page Title - H1 Edit the text for the post type title. 2. Search Results Page Sub-Title - H2 If desired, add a subtitle. 3. Search Results per Page This controls how many total results will appear on a search results page by default. 4. Search Results Code The option to edit the header, loop, and footer codes of the search results design is available as well. Additional Settings Different options will become available when clicking on the dropdown. 1. Pagination Display Options Select how pagination is displayed on search result pages, either standard, hidden pagination, or Insta-Load pagination using the Add-On. 2. Order Results By It controls the display order of items based on a database field. Please find more information on How To Change Search Results Sorting Options here. 3. Enable Search Results Cache Set to YES (recommended) to cache search results and load subsequent matching search results more quickly. Set to NO to always query the database for all searches. Note: This cannot be enabled if "Order Results By" is set to "Random". 4. Respect Membership Plan Search Priority? Membership Plan Search Results Priority can be set up in the Search Visibility tab on each plan. 5. Sidebar To Use Name of the Sidebar that will be displayed on the search result pages, either custom or default. 6. Sidebar Search Module Choose which search widget you would like to display in the sidebar of search results for this post type. This will only work if in the Sidebar Manager the sidebar has the Bootstrap Theme - Search Module - Dynamic Sidebar Search widget. This widget loads the search widget specified on each post type. 7. Sidebar Position on Mobile Devices Choose to display the sidebar below (Bottom), above (Top) the results on search results pages, or hide it only on mobile devices (phones and tablets). 8. Display Google Map Option on Search Results Pages Selecting "Yes" will display a map icon at the top of search results pages. Clicking on this icon will display the search results as pins on a Google Map. 9. Start Results View In Choose either list view, map view, or grid view if you have the Grid View Search Results Add-On. 10. Display Expired Posts in Search Results If YES, will display expired posts on search results pages. Notifications The main difference from other post type settings is the Notifications tab, where it is possible to enable or disable the following email notifications: Admin Notifications Notify Admin when review submitted? When enabled it will send the admin-review-notification Email Template to the Default Website Email address when a review is submitted. Notify the Admin that a review has been responded to? When enabled, send out a notification to the Admin that a review has been responded to. Member Notifications Notify Member when they receive a review?: Turning on this setting will send the recommendation-member Email Template to the member's email address when they receive a review. Please note this does not apply if admin needs to manually approve review. Submitter Notifications Notify the submitter of a review that it has been received?: Sends the recommendation-visitor Email Template to the submitter of a review after it has been received. Notify the submitter of a review that it has been approved?: Sends the recommendation-accepted Email Template to the submitter of a review after it has been published. Notify the submitter of a review that it has been responded to?: Sends the recommendation-submitter-replied Email Template to the submitter of a review after it has received a reply from the member. Review Module Review ID. Actions drop-down. ( Explained below ) Date the review was submitted. IP Address of the review submitter. It can be blocked if it ends up being a SPAM submission. Quick Edit options for the member: Actions This section will allow the admin edit or delete the review submitted: Edit review: While we do not recommend editing reviews, the option is there for all directory owners to control what gets published on the website. Delete review: One can quickly delete any undesired review on the website. Review Details The last section of this module includes the details of the review: This would include: Status Rating Overview Title Full review Name of the review submitter Email of the review submitter From here the status of the review can be changed manually: If the status is changed manually, 4 new options will show up: Do not send email notifications Email Member about this update Email Reviewer about this update Email Member and Reviewer about this update Member Reviews on the Profiles Members can leave reviews on profiles by clicking the “ Write a Review ” button. This feature allows users to share their experiences and feedback directly on the member’s profile. It will display within their profile and search results page. Leaving a Review To leave a review, visitors can visit the member's profile and click on the "Write a Review" button. Which will open up the Reviews form: Update Reviews URL By default, the slug URL of the reviews is /writeareview but if the admin wishes to update this they can follow the instructions below. To change this default URL go to: Settings > Advanced Settings > Default Member Review URL The admin can provide a new slug for the reviews. Uploading Images to a Review If the option for Image Upload With Reviews is enabled in the Membership Plan > Profile Page : The user will get to a second screen that allows them to upload images: How the Reviews will Display on Member's Profile All reviews are then shown in the "Reviews" tab and the star rating is shown above the "Write a Review" button. Reviews are displayed allowing one decimal place for review totals: Reviews will have their designated search results page /reviews where visitors can check all the reviews that have been submitted to the site: Click to View Reviews for a Specific Member As well, visitors can click directly on the overall rating to view all the reviews for a member, this can be in the Search Results or in their profiles: It will open a new page where it will display all the reviews for the member selected. Time Format of the Review The date format showing on the reviews search results page will correspond to the one selected under Settings » General Settings » Localization :

title: Member Images: Importing Members with Profile Photos, Logos & Cover Photos
content: Member Images: Importing Members with Profile Photos, Logos & Cover Photos Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000046959 Importing members requires clean, unformatted text data (no line breaks or styling) mapping to the proper columns to ensure a successful upload. How To Import Members Via CSV File This includes the links for the images that will be uploaded with the file. Add Image URL to Import File Insert the URL for the image into the corresponding field: logo profile_photo cover_photo Currently, the import tool supports the following image formats: webp jpg / jpeg png gif Cover Photo The Profile Cover Photo add-on must be active on the website for imported cover photos to display on member profiles. Hosting Images These images can be uploaded to the Media Manager in order to guarantee a successful upload. Once the images are uploaded to the Media Manager, their URL can be grabbed by clicking on the Copy URL option: The images can also be hosted on external platforms, however, t his tool is meant to help in migrating a site from one platform to another, not to copy images from a 3rd party source without their consent. For in-depth information about the Media Manager check out this link: >> Media Manager Folder Importing Member Images Please follow these steps to import all of the images to the members that were just imported: Navigate to the Members >> Member Images: ** Important Note: This tab will only display if the system identifies recently imported images through the member import template. ** Choose an appropriate number of members to import the images of at a time in the dropdown below: Click on " Update Results ": Use the Bulk Actions checkbox to select all of the members on the page, then select Fetch from Source and Resize Photos from the dropdown menu. If prompted, check the Select All option to include all remaining records. Click the " Apply Action " button. There will be a notification that the images are being processed: Do not close the window or navigate away from the page during this process. Repeat the steps above for each page until all images have been fetched and resized.

title: 07/06/18 - Software Updates
content: 07/06/18 - Software Updates Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047004 We made updates to several Default Widgets this week. If you have customized any of these widgets and would like to update your customized widget, you can find the latest code in the corresponding Default Widget. Please remember that if you have a custom version of any of these widgets, our latest updates have not been pushed to your website. Updates: We applied a UI update to show the "Past Due" status on the Member Dashboard when the member has a Past Due invoice and the auto_suspend_accounts advanced setting is set to 1. Widgets Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Member Dashboard Bootstrap Theme - Header - Member Links Now the two buttons at the bottom of the Login Form can be controlled through a menu. You can find the new menu with the name "Login Page Links" on the Menu Manager page in the Admin area. We fixed an issue which was not allowing for an Admin to login to a member's account from the Admin area when the auto_suspend_accounts advanced setting was set to 1. We updated the Post Categories field validation in order to support the "&" symbol. We removed the ability to Clone/Delete the homepage Static Page through the Admin area to makes sites more stables and avoid user error.  We also removed the "Home" option from the "Page Type" dropdown when editing a static page and made this a protected Page Type only used for the site's homepage. We removed the additional "Purchase Lead" and "Accept Lead" buttons from the Lead Preview page in the Member Dashboard to de-clutter the design.. Widget Involved: Bootstrap Theme - Account - Leads Details Page - New Lead System We added the ability to set a unique image URL to be used for the logo on PDF invoices produced by the system through the billing_logo_url Advanced Setting. This is useful for sites that need to use a logo in PDF invoices that is different from the website's logo. We fixed an issue which was affecting the normal behavior of the Google Map on the Member Profile Page when the Overview tab's "Tab Order" is set to something other than 1.

title: Content » Web Page Builder
content: Content » Web Page Builder Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047120 A Static Page is a page that does not have any dynamic content. The website only comes with a few default static pages since the majority of the web pages are Dynamic Pages (search result pages, profile pages, and post content). Some of the most common default Static Pages include: Homepage - Can only be one Homepage Login Page Pricing Page How It Works Contact Us Page Privacy Policy Terms of Use Search By Location Search By Category Get Matched Password Retrieval It is possible to locate the existing Static Pages by going to Content > Web Page Builder: Edit Existing Pages To edit the pages, click the Edit button. Edit the Homepage The Homepage cannot be edited through the WebPage Builder; instead, it has a specific section in the Design Settings where it can be managed. To learn how to edit the Homepage, refer to this article: Homepage » Front & Back End Overview Actions Dropdown To view, clone, or delete an existing static page, hover over Actions and select accordingly: View Page Redirects the admin to the page on the front end. It shows how members and visitors see the page. Clone Page This action will clone the page exactly how it is. The admin will be required to change the Permalink since two pages cannot have the same one. Delete Click here to permanently delete the page, it cannot be recovered unless a backup is done to the site. Keyword Search Use the search field to search all web pages by keyword. Sort Options The Web Page Builder comes with a set of sort options to arrange the pages according to the selected filter. Sort by: Page ID Low - High Page ID High - Low Name A - Z Name Z - A Last Update - Ascending Last Update - Descending URL A - Z URL Z -A Filter by Access The Web Page Builder comes with a set of filter by Access options to arrange the pages according to the selected filter. Filter by Access: Any Access Level Public For Everyone Only Allow Members Digital Products Buyers Filter by Type The Web Page Builder comes with a set of filter by Type options to arrange the pages according to the selected filter. Filter by Type: Any Page Type Home Page Single Web Page Post Search Results Member Search Results Custom Widget as Web Page Password Retrieval Page Unsubscribed Page Create a New Web Page To learn how to create a new Static Page, click the link below: How to Create a New Static Page Hide Web Pages To hide a web page, change the URL to something only the site administrator would know to visit: /join_DRAFT This essentially marks the page as " unpublished " from the website.

title: How to Create a New Static Page
content: How to Create a New Static Page Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047125 To create a new static page for the website so the admin can add their own personal content, follow the steps below: In the Admin area go to: My Content Web Page Builder Click on" New Web Page+ ": When adding the content to this page, make sure to also set the permalink (the URL name option. e.g.: family, meet-the-team, franchise, etc.) apart from any other content. The most common areas used in this section of the admin are described in the images and points below. 1. Permalink Add a unique value with no spaces or special characters. It is important not to use the same URL structure used by the membership features as this will be a conflict in the system. Once the page has been saved, click on the "View Page" button to visit it. 2. H1 The primary title for the webpage. The size of the H1 is controlled in Design Settings in the "Search Results Design" tab. 3. H2 Subtitle for the webpage. This is also controlled in Design Settings in the "Search Results Design" tab. 4. Page Content Use the Froala Editor and its different available options to add content to the page.  Use the BD Butler to design a unique page with AI. 5. Hero Section This tab enables the Hero Section. How to add a Hero Section on Static Pages 6. SEO Settings Here the SEO & Social Media settings can be configured. How To Edit The SEO & Social Media Elements Of A Static Web Page 7. Advanced These are the advanced settings used to edit further the webpage. 8. Internal Name Include the name of the page to recognize it easily in the Web Page Builder. Customize Page Level CSS Style Add custom CSS to this specific page. Customize the Page Level HEAD Tags Add custom HEAD tags to work only on this page. C ustomize Page Level Footer Javascript Add a custom footer code that will only work on this page. 9. Save Web Page When the work on the page has been completed, click on "Save Web Page" To make the new web page visible to others either add it to the main menu or add a link to an existing page that points to the new page that has been created. 9. Load Previous Versions Each time a static page is saved, a backup version is stored automatically. Brilliant Directories saves up to 10 previous versions of each page. To retrieve a previous version click on Select Revisions and a dropdown menu will appear showing all saved versions, labeled with the date and time they were saved. This will also show the email of the admin that saved this version. Select the version to be reviewed, then click Load Version to replace the current content with that version: Back to Current Once a previous version is loaded, an additional option appears, allowing the user to return to the most recent version of the page if needed.  Click on " Back to Current " to revert to the current or most recent version if needed.

title: How to Create a Sidebar
content: How to Create a Sidebar Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047136 To create a new sidebar, navigate to Toolbox » Sidebar Manager , then click the " New Sidebar " button: Then name the new sidebar: The new sidebar is ready to use: The new sidebar starts out empty. Click Edit to search for widgets and drag them into place. See Toolbox » Sidebar Manager for the full editing steps and Popular Sidebar Widgets for widget suggestions. Tip: If an existing sidebar is close to what is needed, cloning it from the Actions drop-down can be faster than building a new one from scratch. Additional Information: » Toolbox » Sidebar Manager

title: Webpage Builder: Page Details Tab & Page Options Tab
content: Webpage Builder: Page Details Tab & Page Options Tab Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000047142 Navigate to My Content >> Web Page Builder >> then click " Edit " for the existing page or click the New Web Page button to create a new web page: Within the web page editor, the following options will be available in the sidebar: Page Details Tab This section allows users to control key attributes of a page and update its accessibility or structure. 1. Internal Nickname This is an internal reference name for the page. It is not visible to users on the front end, but it helps with organization and searchability. 2. Page Type Select the type of page you are creating. Learn more about page types here: What Page Types Can I Use? 3. Protect This Page? Enable this setting to restrict access to members only. This requires the Members-Only add-on. Page Options Tab Use this tab to customize the layout, visibility, and structure of the page using the following options. 1. Show Sidebar Choose which sidebar to display on the page. 2. Sidebar Position Set whether the sidebar appears on the left or right side of the page. 3. Sidebar Position on Mobile Devices Set where the sidebar appears when the page is viewed on a phone: Top : the sidebar is shown above the page content. Bottom : the sidebar is shown below the page content. This is the default. Hide : the sidebar is not shown on phones. This setting applies to screens narrower than 768 pixels. Tablets and phones turned sideways are usually wider than that, so they keep the desktop layout. Desktop screens are not affected. 4. Display Settings Customize the page’s appearance with these options: Full Screen Page Width Expands the page content to fill the entire width of the browser window, removing any margins. Hide Banner Ad Modules Removes any banner advertisements that would normally display on the page. Hide Header Hides the entire header section of the website on this specific page. Hide Footer Prevents the footer from appearing at the bottom of the page. Hide Top Header Menu Removes the top navigation menu from the page. Hide Main Menu Hides the main navigation menu that is typically displayed at the top of the site. Click-Enlarge Images Allows users to click images to view a larger version in a pop-up window. 5. Advanced Options These options provide more advanced control of the web page, such as search engine indexing and stylesheet behavior. Apply NoIndex, NoFollow This setting prevents the page from appearing in the sitemap and stops search engines from indexing it. If the page is set to Members Only, this option is enabled by default. More information: Members-Only Pages Disable Default CSS Stylesheets Prevents the page from inheriting the default CSS styles. Learn more: How to Override and Edit Default CSS Stylesheets Disable Screenshot Preview Prevents a screenshot preview of the page from appearing in the Web Page Builder. 6. Breadcrumbs Enable breadcrumb navigation to improve user experience. Learn more here: Common Breadcrumb Variables . The accepted format for custom breadcrumbs is: Blog | /blog > Partner | https://example.com > My Page Format rules: > — Separates each breadcrumb level. | — Assigns a URL to the breadcrumb immediately before it. Both relative URLs (such as /blog ) and absolute URLs (such as https://example.com ) are supported. How it works: The text before the | is the breadcrumb label that will be displayed. The URL after the | is the destination for that breadcrumb. Each > creates the next level in the breadcrumb trail. The final breadcrumb can be plain text without a URL if it represents the current page. Example: Blog | /blog > Partner | https://example.com > My Page This will generate the following breadcrumb trail: Home > Blog > Partner > My Page Where: Blog links to /blog Partner links to https://example.com My Page is the current page and is not linked. Note: Do not include Home in your custom breadcrumb string, as it is added automatically by the system. Pre-Made Elements Pre-built content elements are available for use in custom web pages and landing pages. They can be used to create a wide variety of custom landing pages. More info: Web Page Builder » Pre-Made Elements Additional Information Web pages can include sidebars. See: How to Create a Sidebar
